`examples/unity/BaselineEmitter.cs`:

```cs
// fpsdet event emitter for a Unity dedicated server.
//
// Writes one JSON object per line (NDJSON) for every shot and every movement
// sample the server accepts. Field names match schema/combat_event.schema.json.
// Feed the file to `fpsdet ingest`, or ship it to your collector.
//
// Server only. The #if below compiles this file into dedicated server builds
// (UNITY_SERVER, set by the Dedicated Server build target) and into the editor
// (UNITY_EDITOR, so you can try it in Play Mode). Player builds do not contain
// it, so no client can write its own line. Wrap your calls in the same #if, or
// player builds will not compile. Call it from server-authoritative code, after
// the server has decided the hit with its own trace.
//
// Usage:
//   BaselineEmitter.BeginMatch("your-game", "m-1001");          // main thread, at match start
//   BaselineEmitter.Shot(pseudonym, BaselineEmitter.MatchTimeMs, "average", "rifle", hit: true,
//       weaponId: "ak-74", hitbox: "head", distanceM: 42.5);
//   BaselineEmitter.Movement(pseudonym, BaselineEmitter.MatchTimeMs, "average",
//       speedMps: 5.4, onGround: true, displacementCause: DisplacementCause.None,
//       loadoutWeightKg: 14.2, expectedMaxGroundSpeedMps: 6.1);
//
// t_ms is milliseconds since match start on the server clock, not wall time.
// MatchTimeMs is one source; your own server tick time works too.
// game_id and match_id are set once by BeginMatch: one match per server process.
//
// Every optional argument is nullable. Null is left out of the line. So is
// NaN or Infinity: a number that is not finite is omitted, never written.
// Strings are fully JSON-escaped. Numbers use the invariant culture, so a
// server running in a "1,5" locale still writes 1.5.
//
// Other schema fields (map_id, through_geometry, private_track_ms,
// wire_error_deg, picture_error_deg, interp_delay_ms, acquire_ms) follow the
// same pattern: add a nullable parameter and one Str/Num/Bool call.

#if UNITY_SERVER || UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Fpsdet
{
    /// <summary>Where finished lines go. Set BaselineEmitter.Sink to use your own (a socket, a log shipper).</summary>
    public interface IEventSink : IDisposable
    {
        /// <summary>Write one complete JSON object. The sink adds the newline.</summary>
        void WriteLine(string json);
    }

    /// <summary>Appends lines to a UTF-8 file. AutoFlush, so a crash loses at most the line being written.</summary>
    public sealed class FileSink : IEventSink
    {
        readonly StreamWriter writer;

        public FileSink(string path)
        {
            FilePath = path;
            string folder = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(folder))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            }
            // FileShare.Read lets a log shipper tail the file while the server writes it.
            var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Append, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
            writer = new StreamWriter(stream, new UTF8Encoding(false)) { AutoFlush = true };
        }

        public string FilePath { get; private set; }

        public void WriteLine(string json)
        {
            writer.Write(json);
            writer.Write('\n');
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            writer.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Values for displacement_cause. None is a normal sprint. Any other value is excluded from the speed check.</summary>
    public static class DisplacementCause
    {
        public const string None = "none";
        public const string Unknown = "unknown";
        public const string Explosion = "explosion";
        public const string Knockback = "knockback";
        public const string Ragdoll = "ragdoll";
        public const string Vehicle = "vehicle";
        public const string Parachute = "parachute";
        public const string Ladder = "ladder";
        public const string Ability = "ability";
        public const string Launch = "launch";
        public const string TeleportVolume = "teleport_volume";
        public const string Zipline = "zipline";
        public const string Admin = "admin";
    }

    /// <summary>Values for information_state: what this client could know about that enemy, by the server's own queries.</summary>
    public static class InformationState
    {
        public const string Visible = "visible";
        public const string Audio = "audio";
        /// <summary>The server's line-of-sight and audio queries both failed for this client. A wrong label manufactures a case.</summary>
        public const string Unknowable = "unknowable";
    }

    public static class BaselineEmitter
    {
        static readonly object gate = new object();
        static readonly Stopwatch matchClock = new Stopwatch();
        static IEventSink sink;
        static bool quitHooked;
        static bool warned;
        static string gameId;
        static string matchId;

        /// <summary>Also write a server wall-clock "utc" field. fpsdet ingest uses it to pick the day folder.</summary>
        public static bool WriteUtc = true;

        /// <summary>
        /// Where lines are written. Defaults to a new file under
        /// Application.persistentDataPath/fpsdet/ on the first line. Setting it disposes the previous sink.
        /// </summary>
        public static IEventSink Sink
        {
            get
            {
                lock (gate)
                {
                    return sink;
                }
            }
            set
            {
                lock (gate)
                {
                    if (sink != null && !ReferenceEquals(sink, value))
                    {
                        sink.Dispose();
                    }
                    sink = value;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Milliseconds since BeginMatch, from a monotonic clock.</summary>
        public static long MatchTimeMs
        {
            get { return matchClock.ElapsedMilliseconds; }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Call on the main thread when a match starts. Sets game_id and match_id for every
        /// following line, restarts the match clock, and opens the default file if no sink is set.
        /// </summary>
        public static void BeginMatch(string game, string match)
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                gameId = game;
                matchId = match;
                matchClock.Reset();
                matchClock.Start();
                // Application.persistentDataPath has to be read on the main thread, so open here.
                if (sink == null)
                {
                    sink = DefaultSink();
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Flush and close the sink. Runs automatically when the application quits.</summary>
        public static void Close()
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                if (sink != null)
                {
                    sink.Dispose();
                    sink = null;
                }
            }
        }

        static IEventSink DefaultSink()
        {
            if (!quitHooked)
            {
                Application.quitting += Close;
                quitHooked = true;
            }
            // A new file per server process, so two processes never append to the same file.
            string name = string.Format(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                "events-{0:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}-{1}.ndjson",
                DateTime.UtcNow,
                Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8));
            string path = Path.Combine(Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "fpsdet"), name);
            return new FileSink(path);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// One line per shot the server accepted, after the server decided the hit.
        /// skillBand: developing, average, advanced, elite, or unrated.
        /// hitbox: head, upper_torso, lower_torso, or limbs. Null on a miss.
        /// modSet: null means "not sent". An empty array means "no attachments".
        /// informationState: see InformationState. Send it with enemyId and aimJitterDeg, or not at all.
        /// sincePerceivedMs: milliseconds since this client last saw or heard enemyId,
        /// by the server's own line-of-sight and audio queries.
        /// </summary>
        public static void Shot(
            string playerId,
            long tMs,
            string skillBand,
            string weaponClass,
            bool hit,
            string weaponId = null,
            string[] modSet = null,
            string hitbox = null,
            double? distanceM = null,
            int? sprayIndex = null,
            double? recoilPitchDeg = null,
            double? appliedRecoilPitchDeg = null,
            double? compensationPitchDeg = null,
            double? expectedMinRecoilPitchDeg = null,
            string informationState = null,
            string enemyId = null,
            double? aimJitterDeg = null,
            double? hiddenTrackMs = null,
            double? sincePerceivedMs = null,
            string partyId = null)
        {
            var line = new Line(playerId, tMs, "shot", skillBand);
            line.Str("party_id", partyId);
            line.Str("weapon_class", weaponClass);
            line.Str("weapon_id", weaponId);
            line.StrArray("mod_set", modSet);
            line.Bool("hit", hit);
            line.Str("hitbox", hitbox);
            line.Num("distance_m", distanceM);
            line.Int("spray_index", sprayIndex);
            line.Num("recoil_pitch_deg", recoilPitchDeg);
            line.Num("applied_recoil_pitch_deg", appliedRecoilPitchDeg);
            line.Num("compensation_pitch_deg", compensationPitchDeg);
            line.Num("expected_min_recoil_pitch_deg", expectedMinRecoilPitchDeg);
            line.Str("information_state", informationState);
            line.Str("enemy_id", enemyId);
            line.Num("aim_jitter_deg", aimJitterDeg);
            line.Num("hidden_track_ms", hiddenTrackMs);
            line.Num("since_perceived_ms", sincePerceivedMs);
            Write(line.Finish());
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// One line per movement sample. Send on a fixed cadence (10 Hz is enough), not only on shots.
        /// onGround must be true for the sample to count as ground speed.
        /// displacementCause: DisplacementCause.None for a normal sprint, otherwise why the body moved.
        /// expectedMaxGroundSpeedMps: the cap the server applied this tick, after weight, stance, and perks.
        /// It wins over the profile's weight table, so send it when you have it.
        /// </summary>
        public static void Movement(
            string playerId,
            long tMs,
            string skillBand,
            double speedMps,
            bool onGround,
            string displacementCause,
            double? loadoutWeightKg = null,
            double? expectedMaxGroundSpeedMps = null)
        {
            var line = new Line(playerId, tMs, "movement", skillBand);
            line.Num("speed_mps", speedMps);
            line.Bool("on_ground", onGround);
            line.Str("displacement_cause", displacementCause);
            line.Num("loadout_weight_kg", loadoutWeightKg);
            line.Num("expected_max_ground_speed_mps", expectedMaxGroundSpeedMps);
            Write(line.Finish());
        }

        static void Write(string json)
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                if (sink == null || matchId == null)
                {
                    // No BeginMatch yet: no match_id, and no safe place to open the file from.
                    if (!warned)
                    {
                        UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("fpsdet: call BaselineEmitter.BeginMatch before emitting. Line dropped.");
                        warned = true;
                    }
                    return;
                }
                sink.WriteLine(json);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Builds one JSON object. Null and non-finite values are left out.</summary>
        sealed class Line
        {
            static readonly CultureInfo Inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
            readonly StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(512);

            public Line(string playerId, long tMs, string eventType, string skillBand)
            {
                b.Append('{');
                Str("game_id", gameId);
                Str("match_id", matchId);
                Str("player_id", playerId);
                Raw("t_ms", tMs.ToString(Inv));
                if (WriteUtc)
                {
                    Str("utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.fff'Z'", Inv));
                }
                Str("event_type", eventType);
                Str("skill_band", skillBand);
            }

            public void Str(string key, string value)
            {
                if (value == null)
                {
                    return;
                }
                Key(key);
                AppendString(value);
            }

            public void StrArray(string key, string[] values)
            {
                if (values == null)
                {
                    return;
                }
                Key(key);
                b.Append('[');
                bool first = true;
                foreach (string value in values)
                {
                    if (value == null)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (!first)
                    {
                        b.Append(',');
                    }
                    AppendString(value);
                    first = false;
                }
                b.Append(']');
            }

            public void Num(string key, double? value)
            {
                if (!value.HasValue || double.IsNaN(value.Value) || double.IsInfinity(value.Value))
                {
                    return;
                }
                // Up to six decimals, never an exponent, always "." as the separator.
                Raw(key, value.Value.ToString("0.######", Inv));
            }

            public void Int(string key, int? value)
            {
                if (value.HasValue)
                {
                    Raw(key, value.Value.ToString(Inv));
                }
            }

            public void Bool(string key, bool? value)
            {
                if (value.HasValue)
                {
                    Raw(key, value.Value ? "true" : "false");
                }
            }

            public string Finish()
            {
                b.Append('}');
                return b.ToString();
            }

            void Raw(string key, string literal)
            {
                Key(key);
                b.Append(literal);
            }

            void Key(string key)
            {
                if (b.Length > 1)
                {
                    b.Append(',');
                }
                AppendString(key);
                b.Append(':');
            }

            // JSON string: quote and backslash escaped, every control character below 0x20 as \u00XX.
            void AppendString(string value)
            {
                b.Append('"');
                foreach (char c in value)
                {
                    if (c == '"')
                    {
                        b.Append("\\\"");
                    }
                    else if (c == '\\')
                    {
                        b.Append("\\\\");
                    }
                    else if (c < 0x20)
                    {
                        b.Append("\\u00").Append(((int)c).ToString("x2", Inv));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        b.Append(c);
                    }
                }
                b.Append('"');
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif

The curves in <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">profiles/</code> are the fallback when a sample has no expected value, and they are how the idea is unit-tested. This does not end cheating.</p>
</section>

<div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 pb-16 max-md:px-4">
  <aside class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5" aria-label="Not affiliated">
    <p class="m-0 max-w-4xl text-sm text-muted"><strong class="font-medium text-ink">Not affiliated.</strong> fpsdet is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Battlestate Games (Escape from Tarkov), Activision (Call of Duty), Electronic Arts or DICE (Battlefield), or the developers of WARDOGS. Those names are trademarks of their owners. They are used here only to describe which fields a server for that kind of game could emit. Only those studios could integrate fpsdet into their games. Nothing on this page comes from them. Where it describes how a game works, it is an assumption from public play and public guides, not knowledge of their servers.</p>
  </aside>
  <h2 class="m-0 mt-12 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Fields a server for these games could fill</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full border-collapse text-left">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Field</th>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Why it exists</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody class="text-sm">
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">weapon_id, mod_set</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Recoil and aim per build. Unknown builds stay untrained.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">loadout_weight_kg</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">The kit they are wearing, after the server's own weight math.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">expected_max_ground_speed_mps</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">The cap for this stance, this weight, this perk, this second.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">speed_mps, on_ground</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">What the body did, and whether it was a sprint rather than a jump.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">displacement_cause</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Blast, vehicle, parachute, ability, ragdoll. The false-positive valve. Only none is scored.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">recoil and its floor</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">No-recoil scripts. Mods are allowed to lower the floor.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">applied kick, command</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Same-tick cancel, then the leftover after that kick is removed.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">information_state</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Whether this client could have known. A bad unknowable label manufactures cases.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">hidden_track_ms</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Time on a mover the server had not made visible.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">private_track_ms</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Time on a replay placed where this client could not see or hear it. No decoy bit.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">wire_error_deg, picture_error_deg, interp_delay_ms</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Error to the snapshot just sent, error to the picture the client draws, and the delay. Omit any one you cannot measure.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono">skill_band</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">The queue they entered, so a pub-stomp is a watch and not a fake elite.</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm text-muted">Extra numbers are a row in <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">extra_metrics</code> plus the field on the event. ADS time, stamina, sway, ergonomics, and time-to-kill fit that slot. The line itself is on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="wire.html">Wire a game</a>.</p>

  <div class="mt-12 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-lg:grid-cols-1">
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-6">
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.6rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">WARDOGS</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Public gear guides describe weight as a movement rule. They list five equipment classes with about these move penalties: lightest 0–10 kg with no penalty, light 10–17 kg about −5%, medium 17–27 kg about −13%, heavy 27–40 kg and super-heavy about −20%. Those penalties are in <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">profiles/wardogs.json</code>. Absolute meters per second are not. A wrong constant would flag legal players. The server's <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">expected_max_ground_speed_mps</code> is the number that scores.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">The same guides describe an adrenaline pen that lowers the equipment weight class. If the server works that way and you score against the raw kit weight, a legal pen looks like a speedhack. Send the cap after the pen, the stance, and the class math.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Tag anything the game has that moves a body (parachute, explosion, ragdoll, vehicle, ladder) for the whole throw, not one sample. On the planted desk, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">weight-cheat</code> is about 10 kg of kit sprinting at 7.1 m/s, on the ground, cause <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code>. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">blasted</code> is the same speed with the cause set, and it stays clean. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">adrenaline</code> is the pen: the curve would flag the weight, and the server cap does not.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-6">
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.6rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Escape from Tarkov</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">From public play, the same shape as WARDOGS, only harsher. Weight and inertia appear to change acceleration and top speed. The weapon, the attachments, the ammo, and ergonomics appear to change recoil and ADS. A server that applies those effects should send its post-effect speed cap and its recoil floor for the assembled gun. A profile of guessed ergo numbers will false-flag.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Grenades, ragdolls, stimulus or pain effects that launch the body, and admin or disconnect corrections are innocence causes. If part of the felt recoil is presented only on the client, score the view delta the server replicated during the spray. A client-only camera shake is not evidence, because a cheat will not play it.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-6">
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.6rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Call of Duty</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">If the build is the weapon plus an attachment list (Gunsmith), the build key is that list, not the weapon class. If recoil differs by barrel, muzzle, underbarrel, and optic, send the floor the server computed for that build.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">If movement caps change by stance, tac-sprint, slide, dive, swim, and perk or specialist speed stay legal when <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">expected_max_ground_speed_mps</code> is the cap of the stance they are in. A profile that only knows walk speed will call tac-sprint a cheat. Tag vehicles, redeploys, and explosions as innocence causes. A killstreak that moves the player or fires for them should be its own <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">weapon_id</code> or an <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">ability</code> cause, so a VTOL does not enter an infantry accuracy cohort. Use the matchmaking bracket of that playlist as the rank band.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-6">
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.6rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Battlefield</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Vehicles are likely the biggest source of false positives. A player inside a vehicle, on a wing, under a parachute, or flung by destruction is not an infantry sprint. Tag <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">vehicle</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">parachute</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">explosion</code>, or <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">knockback</code> for the whole interval, including the exit if the exit launches them.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Do not put vehicle-seat accuracy into the infantry rifle cohort. Send a distinct <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">weapon_class</code> for vehicle weapons so the human ceiling is other vehicle gunners. Tag traversal gadgets as <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">ability</code> or <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">launch</code>. On very large maps, one distance baseline means little. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">map_id</code> is on the event for your own splits. The reference cohort keys distance by weapon and rank.</p>
    </article>
  </div>

  <h2 class="m-0 mt-16 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">What training means</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 max-lg:grid-cols-1">
    <p class="m-0">Training is the cohort file <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">fpsdet baseline</code> writes. It is the distribution of humans on each band, weapon, and build, from the lake you dumped. A new gun, a new mod combination, or a new weight class with no curve stays untrained until <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">min_cohort_players</code> humans have enough samples. Flagging a build you have never measured is how legal players get removed.</p>
    <p class="m-0">The optional brief does not do this training. It explains a case after the numbers exist. A sustained break of the server's own speed cap does not need a model. The bars are on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="scoring.html">Scoring</a>. The files are on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="source.html">Source</a>.</p>
  </div>
</div>
</main>

<section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 pb-2 pt-12 max-md:px-4 max-md:pt-8">
  <div class="grid grid-cols-12 items-end gap-x-12 gap-y-8 max-xl:grid-cols-1">
    <div class="col-span-7 max-xl:col-span-1">
      <p class="prompt m-0"><span class="text-signal-soft">zb@zerobandwidth</span><span class="text-faint">:</span><span class="text-prototype">~/fpsdet</span><span class="text-faint">$</span> <span class="text-ink">What we are building</span><span class="caret" aria-hidden="true"></span></p>
      <h1 class="m-0 mt-5 font-mono text-[3.4rem] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-tighter text-white text-balance max-xl:text-[2.9rem] max-md:text-[2.05rem]">Run the test before you <span class="text-gradient-brand">wire a game.</span></h1>
    </div>
    <p class="col-span-5 m-0 text-lg max-xl:col-span-1"><strong class="font-medium">You are looking at an answer key, and the program that grades it.</strong> Thirty-two fake players. A known decision on each one. fpsdet reads JSON a dedicated server already can write, and it writes a case a person opens. It does not install on a player’s PC. It does not ban. This does not end cheating.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-10 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-md:grid-cols-1">
    <div class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <p class="m-0 text-sm text-muted">From the repo, Python 3.11 or newer. No packages to install.</p>
      <pre class="m-0 mt-4 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-r-lg border-l-[3px] border-signal bg-plot px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[13px] leading-normal"><code>PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m fpsdet demo</code></pre>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm text-muted">The terminal prints one line per player: reviews first, then watches, then clean. Look for these two rows. They are the whole pitch: the same 7.1 m/s sprint on 10 kg of kit, and only the second one was tagged by the server as a blast. The last line says the planted cases matched.</p>
      <pre class="m-0 mt-4 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-r-lg border-l-[3px] border-clean bg-plot px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[13px] leading-normal"><code>…
weight-cheat    review
…
blasted         clean
…
Planted cases matched profiles/example-loadout.json.</code></pre>
    </div>
    <div class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <p class="m-0 text-sm text-muted">A second command shows the tool refusing to guess. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">examples/shot.jsonl</code> is one legal shot, one legal step, and one step at 18 m/s tagged as an explosion.</p>
      <pre class="m-0 mt-4 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-r-lg border-l-[3px] border-signal bg-plot px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[13px] leading-normal"><code>PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m fpsdet score examples/shot.jsonl --profile profiles/example-loadout.json</code></pre>
      <pre class="m-0 mt-4 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-r-lg border-l-[3px] border-info bg-plot px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[13px] leading-normal"><code>p-1044    insufficient_data</code></pre>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4 text-sm text-muted">The reason says the explosion sample was excluded. One fast sample is not a case. A case needs a sustained run. That refusal is what you want on a short log.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 pb-6 pt-16 max-md:px-4 max-md:pt-12" aria-labelledby="left-pc">
  <p class="zb-kicker">Why the server</p>
  <h2 id="left-pc" class="m-0 mt-4 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white text-balance max-md:text-[1.6rem]">The cheat left the PC. Its commands did not.</h2>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl">A kernel driver watches processes on the player’s PC. A DMA card, a second PC, or a capture card runs the cheat where that driver never runs. Every move and every shot still has to be accepted by the dedicated server. fpsdet reads what the server accepted, beside what the server already knew.</p>
  <figure class="m-0 mt-8">
    <div class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)] max-lg:grid-cols-1">
      <div class="rounded-xl flex flex-col border border-line border-t-[3px] border-t-review panel p-5">
        <p class="m-0 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-review" aria-hidden="true"></span>Off the PC</p>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-3 text-lg font-medium">Where the cheat runs now</h3>
        <ul class="m-0 mt-3 list-none space-y-1.5 p-0 text-sm text-muted">
          <li>A DMA card reading game memory</li>
          <li>A second PC doing the aim math</li>
          <li>A capture card reading the screen</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="m-0 mt-auto pt-5 text-sm">No process for a driver to find.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-center max-lg:flex-row max-lg:gap-3 max-lg:py-3">
        <svg class="h-5 w-12 text-muted max-lg:w-8 max-lg:rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 48 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 10h40m-7-7 7 7-7 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] leading-tight text-muted">mouse input</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rounded-xl flex flex-col border border-line border-t-[3px] border-t-muted panel p-5">
        <p class="m-0 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-muted" aria-hidden="true"></span>The player’s PC</p>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-3 text-lg font-medium">Where kernel anti-cheat looks</h3>
        <ul class="m-0 mt-3 list-none space-y-1.5 p-0 text-sm text-muted">
          <li>The game client</li>
          <li>A kernel driver scanning processes and memory</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="m-0 mt-auto pt-5 text-sm">Sees a clean PC and a mouse.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-center max-lg:flex-row max-lg:gap-3 max-lg:py-3">
        <svg class="h-5 w-12 text-muted max-lg:w-8 max-lg:rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 48 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 10h40m-7-7 7 7-7 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] leading-tight text-muted">every command</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rounded-xl flex flex-col border border-line border-t-[3px] border-t-signal panel p-5">
        <p class="m-0 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-signal" aria-hidden="true"></span>Dedicated server</p>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-3 text-lg font-medium">Where fpsdet reads</h3>
        <ul class="m-0 mt-3 list-none space-y-1.5 p-0 text-sm text-muted">
          <li>Accepted every move and every shot</li>
          <li>Applied the speed cap and the kick</li>
          <li>Decided who was visible or audible</li>
          <li>Knows where the client draws each player</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="m-0 mt-auto pt-5 text-sm">Sees what the cheat still had to do.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <figcaption class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl text-sm text-muted">Moving the cheat off the PC does not move it off the server. A capture card still gets through the checks that need a fact the client was never sent. <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="#still">What still gets through</a> is at the bottom of this page.</figcaption>
  </figure>
</section>

<section id="twins" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4" aria-labelledby="twins-title">
  <p class="zb-kicker">The planted pairs</p>
  <h2 id="twins-title" class="m-0 mt-4 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white text-balance max-md:text-[1.6rem]">Same numbers. Opposite answers.</h2>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl">Most of the desk is pairs. One player is cheating. The other has the same speed, the same hits, or the same quiet aim, and is not. A detector that cannot tell them apart bans the wrong one. The middle of each row is what they share. The ends are the one fact that differs. Each end opens that case on the desk.</p>
  <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] border-b border-line pb-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted max-md:hidden" aria-hidden="true">
    <span>Opens a case</span><span class="text-center">What they share</span><span class="text-right">Stays clean</span>
  </div>

<section id="answer-key" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4" aria-labelledby="key-title">
  <p class="zb-kicker">The answer key</p>
  <h2 id="key-title" class="m-0 mt-4 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white text-balance max-md:text-[1.6rem]">Thirty-two players. Every answer is known.</h2>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-4xl">Then open <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="../demo/board.html">demo/board.html</a>. That page is the same result, with the charts. The header reads 11 to open, 4 to watch, 16 clean, 1 held. Tape 01 is a 10 kg kit holding 7.1 m/s, cap 5.6, beside the same sprint tagged as a blast. The blast is clean. If those two decisions move, the scorer changed. This file is the spec. Later, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">wire-lock</code> is a review and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">picture-track</code> is clean. Same enemy. Same hits.</p>

  </figure>
</section>

  <section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4">
    <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white max-md:text-[1.6rem]">What will fire</h2>
    <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl">Four checks. The first two are ordinary, and they work. The third catches a body the official client never drew. The fourth is two positions of a player they can see. None of them ban anyone. Each one is drawn on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="scoring.html#drawn">Scoring</a>.</p>
    <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-md:grid-cols-1">
      <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
        <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Gear the server already applied.</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">A 10 kg kit sprinting at 7.1 m/s when that server’s cap for the kit is 5.6. The same speed, tagged as a blast, is not a case. Fire rate uses the gun’s own cycle. Recoil uses the floor for that build. This is not a new idea. It catches blatant speed, a macro under the legal gap, and a stock gun with no kick. A cheat that stays inside the cap, and jitters its timing by a few milliseconds, walks through it.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
        <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">The clock.</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">The camera is allowed to kick. The case is the player command matching the kick the server just applied, backwards, on that same tick. Pull the same kick one shot later and it stays clean. In a game with a fixed spray pattern, a player who memorised it pulls on time too, so the pattern is removed first and only the part of the kick that changes between sprays is tested. This catches a same-tick no-recoil script. A script that waits one shot and adds a little noise stays quiet. Your server has to log both numbers, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">applied_recoil_pitch_deg</code> and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">compensation_pitch_deg</code>. If you do not have them, this check does nothing.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
        <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">A fact this client was not sent.</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Sustained aim on an enemy this client could neither see nor hear (footsteps count as heard, and so does a body that broke line of sight a moment ago), or on a replay of someone else’s real movement, turned onto another heading, where this client has no sight and no audio. There is no invisible flag. The official client drops that body before draw because it is occluded. A snapshot parser that keeps every player still sees a person running. Sustained aim on it is a review. A four-shot clip of it stays clean.</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">That third check can catch a cheat that aims at bodies in the server snapshot. It cannot catch a DMA read of the frame the game actually drew, or a capture card looking at pixels. Those never receive a body the official client did not draw. If the visibility query is wrong, the case is manufactured. Fix the query before you trust the case.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
        <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">The picture is late.</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Every moving player has two positions. The wire is the snapshot the server just sent. The picture is where the official client draws them, the wire position from one interpolation delay ago. A person aims at the picture. A packet aimbot aims at the wire, often the tick the snapshot arrives. The case is not “too accurate.” Both crosshairs can hit. The case is the error to the wire staying smaller than the error to the picture, across enough shots, before that delay has elapsed. Standing still makes the two positions match, and nothing fires. One shot does not fire. On the desk, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">wire-lock</code> is the review and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">picture-track</code> is clean.</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">That check still misses a capture card looking at the pixels that were drawn, a cheat that reimplements the official interpolator and waits out the delay, and a server that compares against the wrong timeline. A wrong timeline frames a legal player. A listen server can forge the fields. If you cannot measure the two errors and the delay, omit them. The check does nothing.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4" aria-labelledby="flow-title">
    <p class="zb-kicker">How it runs</p>
    <h2 id="flow-title" class="m-0 mt-4 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white text-balance max-md:text-[1.6rem]">One line in. A case out. A person decides.</h2>
    <ol class="m-0 mt-8 grid list-none grid-cols-6 gap-y-6 p-0 max-xl:grid-cols-3 max-md:grid-cols-1">
      <li class="pr-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-signal font-mono text-xs text-ink shadow-[0_0_14px_-4px_var(--color-signal)]">1</span><span class="ml-3 h-px flex-1 bg-line max-md:hidden"></span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">The server writes a line</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">{"speed_mps": 7.1, …}</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Per shot and per movement sample, from the server’s own accept path.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="pr-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-signal font-mono text-xs text-ink shadow-[0_0_14px_-4px_var(--color-signal)]">2</span><span class="ml-3 h-px flex-1 bg-line max-md:hidden"></span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">The lake keeps it</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">game=…/dt=…/events.ndjson</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Append-only files you own. A folder for a solo dev, an object store for a studio.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="pr-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-signal font-mono text-xs text-ink shadow-[0_0_14px_-4px_var(--color-signal)]">3</span><span class="ml-3 h-px flex-1 bg-line max-xl:hidden"></span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">Humans set the bar</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">rank × weapon × build</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Once you have players. Until then, the gear rules run alone.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="pr-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-signal font-mono text-xs text-ink shadow-[0_0_14px_-4px_var(--color-signal)]">4</span><span class="ml-3 h-px flex-1 bg-line max-md:hidden"></span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">The scorer counts</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">gear · clock · knowledge · picture · humans</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">A count, not a model call. Reports move the queue, never the score.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="pr-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-signal font-mono text-xs text-ink shadow-[0_0_14px_-4px_var(--color-signal)]">5</span><span class="ml-3 h-px flex-1 bg-line max-md:hidden"></span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">A case is written</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">case.json · case.html · seal</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Review, watch, clean, or held, with the reasons and the numbers behind them.</p>
      </li>
      <li class="border-l-[3px] border-signal pl-4">
        <div class="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true"><span class="grid h-8 w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-signal font-mono text-xs text-bg">6</span></div>
        <h3 class="m-0 mt-4 text-base font-medium">A person decides</h3>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">automated_action: none</p>
        <p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Wire your ban button to your review tool, after a person looks. Never to the word review.</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 max-xl:grid-cols-2 max-md:grid-cols-1">
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-dashed border-line p-4 text-sm text-muted"><span class="block font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink">Reports</span>Jump the scan queue, clean numbers included. They never add to the score.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-dashed border-line p-4 text-sm text-muted"><span class="block font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink">AI brief, optional</span>Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint writes a paragraph on a case. It cannot change the decision.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-dashed border-line p-4 text-sm text-muted"><span class="block font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink">features.csv</span>Train your own model on reviewer labels. Keep the gear rules beside it.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-dashed border-line p-4 text-sm text-muted"><span class="block font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink">Dashboards</span>Grafana, Elastic, or Splunk read the case JSON. They are viewers, not the detector.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-[1800px] grid-cols-2 gap-10 px-10 py-12 max-lg:grid-cols-1 max-md:px-4">
    <div>
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white max-md:text-[1.6rem]">What you set up on the server</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4">Nothing on the player’s machine. When the dedicated server accepts a shot or a movement sample, append one JSON object. Start with the fields you already compute to move the body.</p>
      <ul class="m-0 mt-4 list-disc space-y-2 pl-5">
        <li><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">loadout_weight_kg</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">speed_mps</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">on_ground</code></li>
        <li><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">expected_max_ground_speed_mps</code> — the cap that server used, after the pen, the stance, and the perks</li>
        <li><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">displacement_cause</code> — <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code> on a real sprint. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">explosion</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">vehicle</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">parachute</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">ability</code> for the whole throw. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">unknown</code> is dropped, not flagged</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4">Score the file with the same command as the example, pointed at your log and your profile. Legal play comes back <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">clean</code> or <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">insufficient_data</code>. A sustained sprint over the cap you sent comes back <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">review</code>. Stop there. Do not wire a ban to that word. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">automated_action</code> is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code> so a hasty integration has to notice it.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4">Add the clock only when you can send the applied kick and the view command. Add the hidden-aim and replay checks only when line-of-sight and audio for that connection are queries you already trust. Add the wire-and-picture check only when the server can measure angular error to the snapshot it just sent, angular error to the position the official client is drawing, and the interpolation delay. Omit any of the three and that shot does not count. Which field turns on which check is drawn on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="wire.html">Wire a game</a>, with the JSON, Unity, Unreal, and Godot shapes. Tarkov, Call of Duty, Battlefield, and WARDOGS are the same fields, on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="games.html">Games</a>. The bars are on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="scoring.html">Scoring</a>.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white max-md:text-[1.6rem]">What you have to lose</h2>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4">An afternoon, and a log line. Cheaters are in every shooter tonight, with a kernel driver and without one. Running the planted test takes nobody off a server.</p>
      <p class="m-0 mt-4">ZeroBandwidth wrote this. No studio is running it. There is no deployment to trust. Reproduce the two decisions above, then try to break them.</p>
      <ul class="m-0 mt-4 list-disc space-y-2 pl-5">
        <li>If a legal slide, a legal mod, or a stim would have been a case, send the cap your server already used.</li>
        <li>If you can sit on the private replay and stay clean, the rule is wrong.</li>
        <li>If you can sit on the wire, ahead of the picture, and stay clean, the rule is wrong.</li>
        <li>If the terminal does not print <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">weight-cheat</code> as review and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">blasted</code> as clean, do not wire anything.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="build" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4" aria-labelledby="build-title">
    <p class="zb-kicker">The baseline, not the ceiling</p>
    <h2 id="build-title" class="m-0 mt-4 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white text-balance max-md:text-[1.6rem]">Build on it. Make it yours.</h2>
    <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl">The contract is one JSON line in and one case out. Everything around that is a slot. Add your game, your numbers, your checks, your model, your desk. The planted answers keep you honest while you do it: plant a cheater and the innocent twin first, then write the rule that separates them.</p>
    <div class="relative mt-8">
      <svg class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full text-line-bright max-lg:hidden" viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
        <g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke">
          <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="16.7" y2="16.7" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="16.7" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="83.3" y2="16.7" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
          <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="16.7" y2="50" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="83.3" y2="50" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
          <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="16.7" y2="83.3" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="83.3" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/><line x1="50" y1="50" x2="83.3" y2="83.3" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>
        </g>
      </svg>
      <div class="relative grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-lg:grid-cols-2 max-lg:gap-4 max-md:grid-cols-1">
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your game</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">profiles/*.json</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Weight classes, caps, recoil floors, innocence causes. WARDOGS and a synthetic loadout ship as examples.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your engine</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">Unity · Unreal · Godot</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Emit from the server’s accept path. The shapes are on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="wire.html">Wire a game</a>.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your numbers</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">extra_metrics</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">ADS time, sway, stamina, time-to-kill. Declare the row, send the field. No code change.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your storage</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">NDJSON → DuckDB · ClickHouse</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Start with a folder. Grow into an object store. The scorer does not care how the line arrived.</p></article>
        <article class="corner-frame rounded-xl border border-signal/50 bg-plot p-6 shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgb(56_200_255/0.15),0_0_40px_-8px_rgb(56_200_255/0.45),0_0_56px_-12px_rgb(168_85_247/0.35)] max-lg:col-span-2 max-lg:row-start-1 max-md:col-span-1">
          <p class="m-0 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-signal" aria-hidden="true"></span>The core</p>
          <p class="m-0 mt-3 font-mono text-[1.45rem] font-bold leading-[1.15] tracking-tight text-white">One line in. A case out.</p>
          <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm text-muted">Gear rules, the clock, the knowledge checks, the picture, human ceilings. Zero runtime dependencies. Thirty-two planted answers and the tests lock it.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your checks</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">src/fpsdet/signals.py</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Plant the cheater and the twin. Write the failing test. Then the rule.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your model</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">features.csv</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Gradient boosting or whatever your team trains, once reviewers have labeled cases. Labels first.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your AI</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">any OpenAI-compatible endpoint</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Local or hosted. It writes the brief on the queue. It cannot change the decision.</p></article>
        <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5"><p class="m-0 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Your desk</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 font-mono text-sm text-ink">case.json · case.html</p><p class="m-0 mt-2 text-sm text-muted">Open it in a browser, or index it where you already look: Grafana, Elastic, Splunk.</p></article>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="rounded-xl mt-8 grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-center gap-6 border border-line border-l-[3px] border-l-watch panel p-5 max-md:grid-cols-1">
      <p class="m-0 text-sm text-muted"><strong class="font-medium text-ink">Free to build on for small studios.</strong> fpsdet is under the <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="https://github.com/Nimdy/detect-FPS-hackers/blob/main/LICENSE.md">PolyForm Small Business License 1.0.0</a>. If your company has fewer than 100 people and less than US$1M revenue last year, you can use it, change it, and ship it in your game. Larger studios and publishers need a commercial license from ZeroBandwidth.</p>
      <a class="btn-signal" href="https://github.com/Nimdy/detect-FPS-hackers/issues">Ask about a license</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="still" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 py-12 max-md:px-4">
    <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[2.05rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white max-md:text-[1.6rem]">What still gets through</h2>
    <div class="mt-8 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 max-xl:grid-cols-2 max-md:grid-cols-1">
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">An aim that never sits on a hidden mover, never sits on the replay, aims at the picture rather than the wire, and does not get quieter when that mover exists.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Aim that stays on the picture the official client draws, including a cheat that waits out the interpolation delay. Standing still, where the snapshot and the picture are the same place.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">A DMA read of the frame the game actually drew, and a capture card looking at pixels.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">A server that scores aim against a position that client was not shown. That manufactures the case.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">A humanizer with its own noise, when that noise also matches human lag and human variance. A callout slow enough to have been a voice. A speed pulse inside the glitch filter. A kick that barely changes from shot to shot. Stamps that all land on one tick. A gun the server itself fired.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">A listen server, or a game that lets the client decide the hit, can forge every field. The contract is a dedicated server. A bad visibility query manufactures the case. Fix the query.</p>
      <p class="rounded-xl col-span-3 m-0 border border-line p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink max-xl:col-span-2 max-md:col-span-1">A person still opens the file. This does not end cheating.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

    <h1 class="m-0 mt-5 font-mono text-[3.4rem] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-tighter text-white text-balance max-xl:text-[2.9rem] max-md:text-[2.05rem]">How a line becomes <span class="text-gradient-brand">a case.</span></h1>
  </div>
  <p class="col-span-7 m-0 max-w-3xl text-lg max-lg:col-span-1">Four outcomes: <strong class="font-medium">review</strong>, <strong class="font-medium">watch</strong>, <strong class="font-medium">clean</strong>, or <strong class="font-medium">held</strong> (<code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">insufficient_data</code>). <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">automated_action</code> is always <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code>. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">recommended_action</code> is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">human_review</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">monitor</code>, or <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code>. A person still decides. This does not end cheating.</p>
</section>

<div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 pb-16 max-md:px-4">
  <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">The decision</h2>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-3xl">Gear rules can open a review on their own. Combat rates need a thick cohort of humans first. A thin cohort does not flag. The build is reported as untrained.</p>
  <div class="mt-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full border-collapse text-left">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Condition</th>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Decision</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Sustained gear break</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-review">review</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Two or more kinds of number past every measured human</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-review">review</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">One such rate, plus the account's own history or a supporting tell</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-review">review</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Past the rank only, a single ceiling hit, a history jump, or two supporting families</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-watch">watch</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Something was compared, and nothing above fired</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-clean">clean</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Nothing was comparable</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-info">held</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <p class="m-0 mt-4 max-w-5xl text-sm text-muted">A sustained gear break is speed, fire interval, blatant or learned recoil, a same-tick recoil mirror, a metronome on a legal cycle, sustained tracking of a hidden mover, sustained aim on a private replay, aim that matches the wire snapshot ahead of the picture, or aim noise that drops only while the server says this client could not have known.</p>

        <div class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 font-mono text-[12px] text-muted max-sm:grid-cols-1 max-sm:gap-2">
          <p class="m-0"><span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-2 w-2 bg-review" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="text-ink">wire-lock</span> · review</span>0.18° off the wire, 2.40° off the picture, 48 shots</p>
          <p class="m-0"><span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-2 w-2 bg-clean" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="text-ink">picture-track</span> · clean</span>0.18° off the picture. Same enemy, same hits</p>
        </div>
        <figcaption class="m-0 mt-auto pt-4 text-sm">Both crosshairs hit. The case is which position the aim explains, before the delay could have caught up. Standing still puts both in one place, and nothing fires.</figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </section>


  <h2 class="m-0 mt-16 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Gear, from the first match</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-lg:grid-cols-1">
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Speed.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Only samples on the ground with <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">displacement_cause</code> of <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">none</code> are scored. The cap is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">expected_max_ground_speed_mps</code> on that sample, else the weight curve in the profile. Over cap means faster than the cap times 1.08. The finding needs a run of at least 25 of those samples, with gaps no larger than 400 ms. A blast, a vehicle, a parachute, an ability, an unknown cause, a cause the profile has not listed, and any airborne sample are excluded. A shorter run is written down as a possible glitch. It does not open a case. The planted desk shows a 10 kg kit at 7.1 m/s, cap 5.6, beside the same sprint tagged as a blast.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Fire interval.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Gaps under that weapon's own minimum, past one tick of slack, and enough of them. This runs even when the aim sample is still too small to score. Stamps that all land on the server tick, and a gun the server itself fired, stay quiet.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Recoil.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Counted once the spray index is at least 3, and the cause is not an innocence tag. The floor is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">expected_min_recoil_pitch_deg</code> on the shot, else the profile row for that build. A run of 10 shots under a quarter of the floor is a review. A compensated gun has a lower floor, so the same pitch can be legal. No floor and no thick cohort: untrained, not flagged. The steadiest legal player on a build is not a review.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Same-tick mirror.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">The camera can still kick. Send the kick the server applied and the signed player command on that same tick. Review when at least 16 shots correlate at −0.90 or below, and that correlation is at least 0.25 more negative than the same series shifted one shot later. A person pulls on a later shot. In a game with a fixed spray pattern, practiced players pull it on time, so the average kick and command at each spray index are removed first and only the part of the kick that changes between sprays is tested. With too few sprays the check waits, unless the profile says every kick is random.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line panel p-5 max-lg:col-span-1">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Metronome.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Fire interval catches gaps under the legal line. A macro that fires on the legal line, with no motor noise, does not. Review at 40 or more gaps, a mean on the legal side of the line, and a standard deviation of 1.0 ms or under.</p>
    </article>
  </div>

  <h2 class="m-0 mt-16 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">A fact this client was not given</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-lg:grid-cols-1">
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Hidden tracking.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted"><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">hidden_track_ms</code> is time, on that shot, since the previous shot, that the aim stayed on an enemy this client could neither see nor hear. Omit it, or send 0, and nothing happens. Audio-labeled shots, and shots within a second of last seeing or hearing that enemy, do not count: following footsteps or a body that just ducked out of sight is human. Review when at least 8 shots are above 0 and the sum is at least 1200 ms. One long sample is not enough. A visibility query that marks a visible enemy as hidden manufactures the case. That is an emitter bug.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Private replay.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted"><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">private_track_ms</code> uses the same bar. The body is someone else's real movement, on another heading, where this client's sight and audio queries both fail. There is no invisible flag. A short crossing stays clean. A body this client could see, labeled private, manufactures the case. The desk draws that route. The score reads only <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">private_track_ms</code>.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">The picture is late.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted"><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">wire_error_deg</code> is the error to the snapshot the server just sent. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">picture_error_deg</code> is the error to the position the official client draws, one <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">interp_delay_ms</code> earlier. Omit any of the three and that shot does not count. A shot counts as wire-led when the delay has started, the picture is at least 0.20° farther than the wire, and the wire error is at most 0.35 of the picture error. That gap is a separation floor, not an accuracy ceiling. The same bar applies: 8 wire-led shots and 1200 ms of summed delay. Standing still does nothing. One shot does nothing. The same hits on the picture stay clean. A server that scores the wrong timeline manufactures the case. There is no new profile knob. This runs even when the aim sample is still too small to score.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Unknowable smoothness.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted"><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">information_state</code> is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">visible</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">audio</code>, or <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">unknowable</code>. Audio is knowable. Review when both sides have at least 12 samples, the knowable median is at least 0.05°, and the unknowable median is at or under 0.35 of that. A player who is smooth the whole time stays clean. A wrong <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">unknowable</code> label manufactures the case.</p>
    </article>
  </div>

  <h2 class="m-0 mt-16 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">After the decision</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 max-xl:grid-cols-2 max-md:grid-cols-1">
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">The same leftover.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Subtract the server kick and the previous kick. What remains is averaged per spray index and compared across accounts on the same build, at least 24 shared spray indices, correlation at or above 0.85. A match is a watch, not a review. If one account is already a review, the other moves up the scan. If neither is a review, both are watches.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">A teammate, before a voice.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">Only after someone in the party is already a review for a hidden mover. Four or more swings on that same still-hidden enemy, in the same match, under 350 ms, are a watch. A lag long enough to have been a voice stays clean.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Reports.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">They change queue order. They do not change the decision, and they are not in the seal. A brigade can make you look today. It cannot convict anyone.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">The seal.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">SHA-256 of the player, the game, the decision, and the reasons. Edit a reason and the hash changes. It identifies the packet a reviewer saw. It is not a ban.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="rounded-xl border border-line p-5 max-xl:col-span-2 max-md:col-span-1">
      <h3 class="m-0 text-base font-medium">Human ceilings.</h3>
      <p class="m-0 mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">One number per player, leave-one-out, in that rank and on that weapon. The cohort is thick at 30 players after the subject is removed. The bound is a one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound, widened when the rate swings between matches more than chance. Past every measured human is review-grade; the same number on two guns counts once. Past the rank only is a watch. A hot ten-shot game has a wide bound and does not clear a maximum.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
  <p class="m-0 mt-6">The precise bars, every default, are <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="https://github.com/Nimdy/detect-FPS-hackers/blob/main/docs/scoring.md">docs/scoring.md</a> in the repository. The planted answers are on <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="../demo/board.html">the desk</a>.</p>
</div>
</main>

<main id="main">
<section class="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-[1800px] grid-cols-12 items-end gap-8 px-10 py-12 max-lg:grid-cols-1 max-md:px-4">
  <div class="col-span-7 max-lg:col-span-1">
    <p class="prompt m-0"><span class="text-signal-soft">zb@zerobandwidth</span><span class="text-faint">:</span><span class="text-prototype">~/fpsdet</span><span class="text-faint">$</span> <span class="text-ink">Source</span><span class="caret" aria-hidden="true"></span></p>
    <h1 class="m-0 mt-5 font-mono text-[3.4rem] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-tighter text-white text-balance max-xl:text-[2.9rem] max-md:text-[2.05rem]">The reference is <span class="text-gradient-brand">the Python in this repo.</span></h1>
  </div>
  <p class="col-span-5 m-0 text-lg max-lg:col-span-1"><strong class="font-medium">fpsdet 0.2.0.</strong> Python 3.11 or newer. No runtime dependencies. A solo dev and a studio run the same contract. A port in another language matches when it reproduces the planted demo and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">tests/test_fpsdet.py</code>. This does not end cheating.</p>
</section>

<div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1800px] px-10 pb-16 max-md:px-4">
  <h2 class="m-0 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">Run the planted matches</h2>
  <pre class="m-0 mt-6 overflow-x-auto border-l-[3px] border-signal bg-plot p-5 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed"><code>PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m fpsdet demo
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_fpsdet
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m fpsdet pages</code></pre>
  <div class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 max-lg:grid-cols-1">
    <p class="m-0"><code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">demo</code> writes <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">demo/board.html</code>. That page starts with a six-step walk-through, then the thirty-two planted players. The first tape is the 10 kg sprint beside the blast. <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">pages</code> writes a folder a static host can serve: these pages, and a fresh desk beside them. Nothing in that command publishes the repository.</p>
    <p class="m-0">The repository is <a class="text-ink underline decoration-line underline-offset-4" href="https://github.com/Nimdy/detect-FPS-hackers">github.com/Nimdy/detect-FPS-hackers</a>. These HTML pages are the walk-through. The same contract, written for an implementer, is <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">docs/scoring.md</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">docs/integration.md</code>, <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">docs/games.md</code>, and <code class="font-mono text-[0.92em]">docs/operations.md</code>.</p>
  </div>

  <h2 class="m-0 mt-16 font-mono text-[1.95rem] font-semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight text-white">What is in the tree</h2>
  <div class="mt-6 overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full border-collapse text-left">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">Path</th>
          <th class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-xs font-normal uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted">What it is</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-sm">src/fpsdet/</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">The reference scorer.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-sm">profiles/</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Curves for the synthetic loadout, and WARDOGS weight classes with no absolute sprint speed.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-sm">tests/</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">The behavior lock, including the planted demo.</td></tr>
        <tr><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6 font-mono text-sm">schema/</td><td class="border-b border-line py-3 pr-6">Event and profile shapes.</td></tr>
